text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Centre-Right Social Democratic Party (PSD) threatens to leave the Parliament debate on February 20 when the alteration to the abortion law will be discussed, the paper learned.
- Portuguese casines made 28.42 billion escudos revenue in 1996, 14 pct more than 1995. It is the end of a stagnation period which started im 1991.
- Ilidio Pinho, the creator of Portuguese biggest packing company Colep told Publico he may involve himself with other partners in the Electricity company EDP privatisation project.
- Police force GNR wants to have the same statute as Public Security Police PSP, the paper learned.
- According to data from Spanisn costums , Madrid exported to Portugal during the first 11 months of 1996, 59 tones of meat.
- Ceramic sector companies will be the first to prudece with natural gas.

- Popular Party (PP) leader in Porto Silvio Cervan is to meet Porto Socialist leader (PS) Narciso Miranda this week, the paper learned from source close to PS Porto. In discussion will be the eventual alliance PP-PS in same Northern councils.

- Antonio Champalimaud denied a bid on Banco Totta & Acores last Friday, , but the market believes the creation of a single bank passes by Totta's the absortion by Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor through a OPT.

- Mobile phones sales doubled in 1996. At the end of 1996 there were more than 663,651 mobile phone users in Portugal, which represents 7 percent penetration taxe. TMN, company which belongs to Portugal Teleciom leads the market and makes profits superior to 7 billion escudos.
